observations.label: Description
observations.text:
1) Speak to Lao'Jin Master Yaol in Tanvu.
2) You must slay the following monsters in Tanvu:
- 2 Kojuko Beholders
- 2 Kojuko Maneaters
- 2 Kojuko Slayers
3) Return to Lao'Jin Master Yaol.

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Lao'Jin Master Yaol
"Master Tallon sent you here to be tested and you shall be. But as I am a bit indisposed at the moment, my pupil, Master Kaol, will need to further you along."

"I sent Kaol, along with the first wave of students, into Tanvu. One of them returned to inform me that the Kojuko gremlins have destroyed one of the outlying magical barriers and currently occupy the route to the city."

"On your way to Kaol, clear the Kojuko from the path so that I may send more students safely through. Good luck."

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Shaof
"Your path to understanding Jin is almost complete. Only two tests remain." "In the hills to our east lie two Jin masters, waiting to give you your final tests. What you have been through up to this point will seem trivial. These masters will test every fiber of your being - pushing your strength, intelligence, wit and resolve to their breaking points." "Master Garu will test your faith." "Master Ashaine will show you the true nature of Jin." "Return to me when both tests are complete." RSS Comments

findings.observation: Primary objective says speak to Master Garu and Master Ashaine. Fandom and two photographed-in-game attributions instead print Obtain the Blessing of Faith and Obtain the Nature of Jin. Accounts remain separate; screenshots were not inspected.
Description says return to Shaof, while Hand in to names Master Garu. Five attributed disagreements about ends npc and level are retained. Neither turn-in identity nor disputed level is resolved.

Notes says Master Garu gives four followup quests, but provides no names in that section. Previous links Eye Of The Beholder reciprocally; Next links The Ra'Jin Grand Master. These do not establish enforced prerequisites or identify all four followups.

No Rewards heading or Coin reward detail occurs in the cached page. Absence of displayed rewards is not evidence of zero rewards. Source link is an archived MMODB mirror, not independent corroboration.
